_comment: Editable collection definitions. Copy this file to
reinstalling the app - that copy wins over this bundled one.
prompts         - what the photo should look like (matched visually).
folder_keywords - matched against the SharePoint folder name. A folder
match is treated as decisive, because a photo sitting
in a folder called 'Familie' is a family photo
regardless of what the pixels suggest. Matching is
require_people  - when true, photos with no guests in them are kept out
of the collection (they stay searchable). Set false
for collections where empty shots are wanted.
